summary: Toronto-Dominion Bank filed a Form 6-K reporting the pricing of a Canadian public offering of C$1.25 billion of 5.918% Non-Viability Contingent Capital AT1 Limited Recourse Capital Notes Series 7. The notes bear a 5.918% annual interest rate, payable quarterly, resetting every five years based on the 5-year Government of Canada Yield plus 2.85%, maturing July 31, 2086. TD Securities acts as lead agent. Net proceeds are for general corporate purposes. The offering is exempt from U.S. registration. This is a routine capital issuance, not a special situation. No action or catalyst for event-driven analysis. Watch for no risk-arb angle.
